name: blockbench-mcp
description: Comprehensive MCP server for Blockbench - modeling, texturing, rigged and group-based animation via Claude

scripts.build: npm run build:plugin && npm run build:server
scripts.build:release: npm run build:plugin && esbuild server/src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/mcp-server.js
